commands.description: Execute the toolkit's mocked ADB / API / CLI test suite.

commands.description: Install or replace an APK on the device.

commands.title: Uninstall package
commands.description: Remove a user-installed package.

commands.title: Clear app data
commands.description: Wipe app data and cache for a package.

commands.title: Live logcat
commands.description: Stream device logs. Filter with tags like ActivityManager:I *:S.

commands.title: Logcat dump recent lines
commands.description: Print the last 100 buffered log lines and exit.

commands.title: Clear logcat buffer
commands.description: Clear the device log buffer before a fresh capture.

commands.title: Screenshot to file
commands.description: Capture the screen as PNG without leaving a temp file on the device.

commands.title: Screen record
commands.description: Record the display (stop with Ctrl+C), then pull the file.

commands.title: Tap coordinates
commands.description: Simulate a tap at the given screen coordinates.

commands.title: Swipe gesture
commands.description: Swipe from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2) over duration ms.

commands.title: Type text
commands.description: Type text into the focused field. Spaces are encoded as %s.

commands.title: Keyevent Back / Home / Power
commands.description: Send a keyevent. 4=Back, 3=Home, 26=Power, 82=Menu.

commands.title: Push file to device
commands.description: Copy a file from the host to the device.

commands.title: Pull file from device
commands.description: Copy a file from the device to the host.

commands.title: List /sdcard
commands.description: List files in shared storage.

commands.title: Wireless disconnect
commands.description: Disconnect a wireless ADB endpoint (or omit target to disconnect all).

commands.title: Select device by serial
commands.description: Target a specific device when multiple are connected.

commands.title: Forward local port
commands.description: Forward a host TCP port to the device.

commands.title: adb devices
commands.description: List connected devices. Shows serial numbers and connection state. Run this first.

commands.title: adb connect 192.168.1.100:5555
commands.description: Connect wirelessly. First enable Wireless Debugging in Developer Options (Android 11+).

commands.title: adb shell
commands.description: Open an interactive shell session on the device. Type exit to close.

commands.title: adb reboot
commands.description: Reboot the device normally. Also: adb reboot bootloader / adb reboot recovery.

commands.title: adb pair 192.168.1.100:PORT
commands.description: Pair wirelessly (Android 11+). Use the pairing code from Wireless Debugging settings.

commands.title: adb kill-server && adb start-server
commands.description: Restart the ADB daemon. Fixes most "device not found" or connection issues.

commands.title: adb shell getprop ro.product.model
commands.description: Get device model name.

commands.title: Get Android OS version number (e
commands.description: Get Android OS version number (e.g. "14").

commands.title: adb shell pm list packages -f
commands.description: List all installed packages with APK file paths. Remove -f for just package names.

commands.title: adb shell pm list packages -3
commands.description: List only user-installed (third-party) packages.

commands.title: adb shell dumpsys battery
commands.description: Full battery status: level, health, temperature, voltage, charging state.

commands.title: Get current screen resolution and DPI density values
commands.command: adb shell wm size && adb shell wm density
commands.description: Get current screen resolution and DPI density values.

commands.title: adb shell cat /proc/meminfo
commands.description: Total and available RAM. MemTotal and MemAvailable are the key values.

commands.title: adb shell df -h
commands.description: Disk usage for all partitions in human-readable format.

commands.title: Set all animations to 0
commands.command:
adb shell settings put global window_animation_scale 0.5
adb shell settings put global transition_animation_scale 0.5
adb shell settings put global animator_duration_scale 0.5
commands.description: Set all animations to 0.5x speed. Use 0 to disable entirely. Makes the phone feel noticeably snappier.

commands.title: Disable all animations entirely
commands.command:
adb shell settings put global window_animation_scale 0
adb shell settings put global transition_animation_scale 0
adb shell settings put global animator_duration_scale 0
commands.description: Disable all animations entirely. Fastest feel, but can look jarring. Restore to 1 to revert.

commands.title: Disable heads-up (floating) notifications
commands.command: adb shell settings put global heads_up_notifications_enabled 0
commands.description: Disable heads-up (floating) notifications. Restore to 1 to re-enable.

commands.title: Show apps holding wake locks
commands.command: adb shell dumpsys power | grep "Wake Locks"
commands.description: Show apps holding wake locks. If battery drains fast, this reveals the culprit.

commands.title: adb shell am force-stop com.package.name
commands.description: Force stop any app by package name. Frees RAM immediately.

commands.title: Tell an app to release memory
commands.command: adb shell am send-trim-memory com.package.name RUNNING_LOW
commands.description: Tell an app to release memory. Useful for heavy apps like Chrome or games.

commands.title: Enable Data Saver globally
commands.command: adb shell cmd netpolicy set restrict-background true
commands.description: Enable Data Saver globally. Restricts background data for all apps not whitelisted.

commands.title: Revoke fine location permission from any app
commands.command: adb shell pm revoke com.package.name android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
commands.description: Revoke fine location permission from any app. Replace package name and permission as needed.

commands.title: List all permissions granted to a specific app
commands.command: adb shell dumpsys package com.package.name | grep permission
commands.description: List all permissions granted to a specific app. Shows both granted and denied.

commands.title: Revoke camera and microphone access
commands.command:
adb shell pm revoke com.package.name android.permission.CAMERA
adb shell pm revoke com.package.name android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
commands.description: Revoke camera and microphone access. Effective for social media apps that don't need them.

commands.title: Disable Google usage statistics reporting
commands.command: adb shell settings put global google_usage_stats_disabled 1
commands.description: Disable Google usage statistics reporting. Part of the Privacy Hardener script.

commands.title: Opt out of ad tracking
commands.command: adb shell settings put secure limit_ad_tracking 1
commands.description: Opt out of ad tracking. Equivalent to "Opt out of Ads Personalization" in Settings.

commands.title: Revoke contacts access
commands.command: adb shell pm revoke com.package.name android.permission.READ_CONTACTS
commands.description: Revoke contacts access. Highly recommended for social apps (LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.).

commands.title: Reset ALL runtime permissions for an app to ungranted state
commands.description: Reset ALL runtime permissions for an app to ungranted state. Nuclear option — app will ask again.

commands.title: Block sensor access (accelerometer, gyro, etc
commands.command: adb shell settings put global sensors_off_for_unknown_apps 1
commands.description: Block sensor access (accelerometer, gyro, etc.) for apps not in foreground. Android 12+.

commands.title: Disable a system app for your user
commands.description: Disable a system app for your user. App stays installed but can't run. Reversible — no root needed.

commands.title: adb shell pm enable com.package.name
commands.description: Re-enable a previously disabled app. Always reversible.

commands.title: Uninstall for current user only
commands.description: Uninstall for current user only. App data kept (-k). Restores on factory reset. Safer than full uninstall.

commands.title: Restore a user-uninstalled system app without factory reset
commands.command: adb shell cmd package install-existing com.package.name
commands.description: Restore a user-uninstalled system app without factory reset.

commands.title: adb shell pm list packages -d
commands.description: List all currently disabled packages. Useful audit of what you've already disabled.

commands.title: Search for packages by keyword
commands.command: adb shell pm list packages | grep -i samsung
commands.description: Search for packages by keyword. Replace "samsung" with your search term.

commands.title: adb shell wm density 420
commands.description: Change display DPI. Lower = more content on screen. Typical range: 320-480. Reset: adb shell wm density reset

commands.title: adb shell wm size 1080x1920
commands.description: Override screen resolution. Reset: adb shell wm size reset. Use with caution — some resolutions cause issues.

commands.title: Set font size scale
commands.command: adb shell settings put system font_scale 1.0
commands.description: Set font size scale. 1.0 = default. Range: 0.85 (smaller) to 1.3 (larger).

commands.title: Set screen brightness (0-255)
commands.command: adb shell settings put system screen_brightness 128
commands.description: Set screen brightness (0-255). Disable auto-brightness first: settings put system screen_brightness_mode 0

commands.title: Record screen to device storage
commands.description: Record screen to device storage. Ctrl+C to stop. Pull with: adb pull /sdcard/record.mp4

commands.title: adb pull /sdcard/DCIM/ ./backup/
commands.description: Copy a folder from device to PC. Works for any path you have permission to access.

commands.title: adb push ./file.apk /sdcard/
commands.description: Copy a file from PC to device storage.

commands.title: adb shell pm path com.package.name
commands.description: Get the APK path of any installed app, then pull it to PC as a backup.

commands.title: adb pull /sdcard/ . 2>&1 | tail -1
commands.description: Pull all of /sdcard/ to current directory. Shows summary of files transferred.

commands.title: adb logcat -d > device_log.txt
commands.description: Dump the current device log buffer to a file. Useful for debugging crashes.

commands.title: Show which apps/UIDs are consuming battery
commands.description: Show which apps/UIDs are consuming battery. Grep filters to the important lines.

commands.title: adb shell dumpsys deviceidle enable
commands.description: Force enable Doze mode immediately (instead of waiting for device to be idle). Good for testing.

commands.title: adb shell dumpsys battery set level 50
commands.command: adb shell dumpsys battery set level 50
commands.description: Simulate battery level for testing. Reset with: adb shell dumpsys battery reset

commands.title: Enable Battery Saver mode
commands.command: adb shell settings put global low_power 1
commands.description: Enable Battery Saver mode. Set to 0 to disable.

commands.title: Check battery temperature
commands.command: adb shell dumpsys battery | grep temperature
commands.description: Check battery temperature. Value is in tenths of degrees Celsius (e.g. 290 = 29.0°C).

commands.title: Launch a specific activity
commands.description: Launch a specific activity. Great for automation and testing.

commands.title: Open a URL on the device from your PC
commands.description: Open a URL on the device from your PC. Works for any intent.

commands.title: adb shell input text "Hello%sWorld"
commands.description: Type text into the focused field. Use %s for spaces. Limited to ASCII only.

commands.title: adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_HOME
commands.description: Simulate button press. Common codes: HOME, BACK, MENU, POWER, VOLUME_UP, VOLUME_DOWN.
